info.title: Finalverse Earth Platform
info.description: API /v1 remains backward compatible with v0.3. Reviewed same-origin app grants are operator-installed, not self-authorized. Generic GeoJSON follows RFC 7946. Temporal instants are the strict UTC subset documented here. Public anonymous endpoints remain read-only and bounded.

post.description: Optional local inference only when explicitly configured and granted. A proposal is validated but not executed.
